message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/freetype2 && git log --oneline -30` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: The vulnerability is a heap-buffer-overflow READ 8 in freetype2. Let me look at the recent commits to understand what changed. The issue is OSS-Fuzz 42499092. Let me look at the git history around the fix.
